title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Master Policy Conditions on Program Set-Up and Termination
content:
**Set-up.** A **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** program is set up on the lender's signed master policy application and takes effect on its program effective date; until then it is enrolled, and on that date it becomes active and placements may begin.

**Termination.** A lender ends a program only by a signed termination notice on file, taking effect no earlier than 90 calendar days (the tier's termination notice period) after Tidemark receives it, and only on a program whose status is active or suspended. The signed notice must be on Tidemark's records; a lender's verbal statement does not end a program.

| Requested effective date, counted from Tidemark's receipt of the signed notice | Acceptable? |
|---|---|
| Earlier than the 90th day after receipt | No |
| The 90th day after receipt or later | Yes |

| Program status | Can a signed termination take effect? |
|---|---|
| Enrolled | No |
| Active | Yes |
| Suspended | Yes |

**After termination.** No new certificate is issued. On every tier the certificates already issued stay in force to their expiration and do not renew, and their credits and claims are still handled. Any credit balance remaining when the last certificate ends is refunded to the lender.
